categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in comprehensive construction services, including public construction projects, social housing, commercial buildings, and factory buildings. It also engages in construction materials sales and invests in subsidiaries specializing in construction and textile manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates advanced technologies such as AI-based construction management systems, including mobile CCTV monitoring, facial recognition with temperature detection, and BIM (Building Information Modeling) for safety and cost control. It also develops mechanized high-altitude spraying robots and adopts precast construction techniques with automation and smart curing technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government agencies and public sector clients for infrastructure and social housing projects, as well as private sector clients in commercial and industrial construction. The company focuses on public engineering tenders and social housing projects, aiming to be a long-term partner for quality owners.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily concentrated in Taiwan, with a subsidiary in Thailand engaged in textile manufacturing. The company’s projects are mainly located in various regions of Taiwan, including Kaohsiung, Pingtung, Tainan, and Hualien.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction supply chain, focusing on project contracting, construction management, and materials procurement. It also manages subcontractors and integrates group resources to expand operational scale.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include pursuing high value-added public construction projects, integrating AI and BIM technologies for construction automation and safety, and expanding into green energy-related construction such as solar and wind power projects. The company emphasizes sustainable development and continuous improvement in governance and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through contract-based construction project income, including public infrastructure, social housing, and commercial building projects. Additional revenue streams include sales of construction materials and investment income from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the Taiwanese construction industry, which includes civil engineering, building construction, and specialized construction sectors. It positions itself as a quality service provider with a focus on public projects and sustainable practices, leveraging its group resources and technological integration to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.34 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 20% increase from the prior year. It has shown steady growth in operating profit and net income, with total assets exceeding NT$4.5 billion and equity of about NT$2 billion. The company maintains a stable financial structure with ongoing capital increases and investment in subsidiaries.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrity, quality, innovation, and environmental responsibility in delivering superior construction services. Its differentiation lies in integrating advanced AI and BIM technologies to enhance safety, quality, and efficiency, as well as its commitment to sustainable development and strong governance practices.
